title: Classic Margherita Pizza
description: A timeless Italian pizza with fresh mozzarella, tomatoes, and fragrant basil.
instructions: Combine flour, yeast, salt, and olive oil. Add warm water and knead for 10 minutes.
Let dough rise in a warm spot for 1 hour until doubled.
Preheat oven to 475°F with a pizza stone inside.
Roll out dough into a 12-inch circle. Spread sauce, add mozzarella.
Bake 12–15 minutes until crust is golden. Top with fresh basil.

title: Chicken Tikka Masala
description: Tender chicken in a rich, spiced tomato-cream sauce served with basmati rice.
instructions: Marinate chicken in yogurt and 1 tbsp spice blend for 1 hour.
Grill or pan-fry chicken until charred. Set aside.
Sauté onion in butter until golden. Add garlic and remaining spices.
Stir in tomatoes and simmer 10 minutes. Add cream and chicken.
Simmer 5 minutes. Garnish with cilantro and serve with rice.

title: Garden Vegetable Stir-Fry
description: A quick and colorful stir-fry bursting with crisp vegetables and savory umami sauce.
instructions: Whisk together soy sauce, sesame oil, ginger, garlic. Set aside.
Heat a wok over high heat. Stir-fry broccoli 2 minutes.
Add peppers and snap peas; stir-fry 3 more minutes.
Pour sauce over vegetables and toss. Cook 1 minute until thickened.
Sprinkle sesame seeds and serve over rice.

title: Beef Tacos
description: Seasoned ground beef in crispy shells with fresh toppings — a family favourite.
instructions: Brown ground beef in a skillet over medium-high heat. Drain fat.
Stir in taco seasoning and 1/4 cup water. Simmer 3 minutes.
Warm taco shells in the oven for 3 minutes.
Fill shells with beef, cheese, lettuce, and tomatoes.
Top with sour cream and salsa.

title: Creamy Mushroom Risotto
description: Velvety Arborio rice cooked with earthy mushrooms and finished with Parmesan.
instructions: Sauté onion in olive oil until translucent. Add garlic and mushrooms.
Stir in rice and toast 1 minute. Pour in wine and stir until absorbed.
Add broth one ladle at a time, stirring continuously for ~20 minutes.
Remove from heat, stir in butter and Parmesan. Season to taste.

title: Lemon Herb Salmon
description: Pan-seared salmon fillets with a bright lemon-dill butter sauce.
instructions: Pat salmon dry and season with salt and pepper.
Sear in olive oil skin-side up 3 minutes; flip and sear 3 more.
Transfer to a 400°F oven for 5 minutes.
Make sauce: melt butter, add garlic, lemon juice, zest, and dill.
Plate salmon and spoon sauce over the top.

title: Classic Hummus
description: Silky-smooth chickpea hummus with tahini, garlic, and a drizzle of olive oil.
instructions: Blend chickpeas, tahini, lemon juice, garlic, and cumin until smooth.
Drizzle in olive oil while blending. Add cold water to adjust consistency.
Season with salt.
Spread in a bowl, drizzle olive oil, and dust with paprika.

title: Spaghetti Carbonara
description: Roman pasta classic made with eggs, Pecorino, guanciale, and black pepper — no cream.
instructions: Cook spaghetti in salted water until al dente. Reserve 1 cup pasta water.
Render guanciale in a cold pan until crispy.
Whisk egg yolks, whole egg, and Pecorino with generous black pepper.
Remove pan from heat. Add drained pasta to guanciale.
Pour egg mixture over pasta, tossing quickly with pasta water until glossy.

title: Avocado Toast with Poached Egg
description: Smashed avocado on sourdough topped with a perfectly poached egg and chilli flakes.
instructions: Toast sourdough until golden. Mash avocado with lemon, salt, and pepper.
Bring a saucepan of water to a simmer; add vinegar.
Swirl water and gently slide in each egg. Poach 3 minutes.
Spread avocado on toast. Top with poached egg and chilli flakes.

title: BBQ Pulled Pork
description: Slow-cooked pork shoulder that falls apart, smothered in smoky barbecue sauce.
instructions: Mix sugar, paprika, garlic powder, cumin, salt, and pepper. Coat pork; refrigerate overnight.
Cook at 275°F covered for 6–8 hours until pull-apart tender.
Shred pork with two forks. Mix in BBQ sauce.
Serve on buns with coleslaw.

title: Greek Salad
description: A refreshing combination of cucumber, tomato, olives, and feta with a herby dressing.
instructions: Combine tomatoes, cucumber, red onion, and olives in a bowl.
Arrange feta on top.
Whisk olive oil, vinegar, oregano, salt, and pepper. Drizzle over salad.
Serve immediately.

title: Shrimp Fried Rice
description: Quick wok fried rice packed with plump shrimp, vegetables, and fluffy egg.
instructions: Stir-fry shrimp in a hot wok 2 minutes; remove and set aside.
Add garlic and vegetables; stir-fry 2 minutes. Scramble eggs in the pan.
Add rice and stir-fry 3 minutes. Return shrimp.
Add soy sauce and sesame oil. Finish with green onions.

title: Banana Oat Pancakes
description: Naturally sweetened, gluten-friendly pancakes using only bananas and oats.
instructions: Blend bananas, oats, eggs, baking powder, vanilla, and cinnamon until smooth.
Heat a non-stick pan over medium heat with butter.
Pour 1/4 cup batter per pancake. Cook 2 minutes, flip, 1 more minute.
Serve stacked with maple syrup and fresh berries.

title: Thai Green Curry
description: Aromatic coconut-milk curry with chicken, green beans, and fresh Thai basil.
instructions: Fry curry paste in coconut cream 1 minute. Add chicken and stir-fry 3 minutes.
Pour in remaining coconut milk and bring to a simmer.
Add green beans and zucchini; simmer 5 minutes.
Season with fish sauce, sugar, and lime. Stir in Thai basil.

title: Caprese Salad
description: Simple Italian salad of tomato, fresh mozzarella, and basil with a balsamic glaze.
instructions: Alternate tomato and mozzarella slices on a platter.
Tuck basil between the slices.
Drizzle with olive oil and balsamic glaze.
Season with salt and pepper. Serve at room temperature.

title: Lamb Chops with Rosemary
description: Herb-crusted lamb chops seared to a perfect blush-pink centre.
instructions: Combine rosemary, garlic, olive oil, lemon zest, salt, and pepper; coat chops.
Marinate 20 minutes at room temperature.
Sear in a cast-iron skillet 3 minutes per side for medium-rare.
Rest 5 minutes before serving.

title: Spinach & Chickpea Curry
description: Hearty, plant-based curry with wilted spinach and spiced chickpeas in a tomato base.
instructions: Sauté onion until golden. Add garlic and spices; cook 1 minute.
Stir in tomatoes and simmer 10 minutes.
Add chickpeas and simmer 10 more minutes.
Stir in spinach until wilted. Season with salt.

title: Eggs Benedict
description: Poached eggs and Canadian bacon on English muffins with classic hollandaise sauce.
instructions: Hollandaise: whisk yolks and lemon juice over simmering water; slowly whisk in butter. Season.
Toast muffins; pan-fry bacon until warm.
Poach eggs in simmering water with vinegar for 3 minutes.
Assemble: muffin → bacon → egg → hollandaise. Garnish with chives.

title: Vegan Black Bean Burgers
description: Hearty plant-based patties with cumin-spiced black beans and a smoky chipotle mayo.
instructions: Mash black beans leaving some texture. Mix in breadcrumbs, flax egg, onion, garlic, and spices.
Form 4 patties; refrigerate 15 minutes.
Cook in oiled pan 4 minutes per side.
Serve on buns with lettuce, tomato, and chipotle mayo.

title: Honey Garlic Glazed Chicken Thighs
description: Sticky, caramelised chicken thighs with a sweet-salty honey-garlic glaze.
instructions: Season chicken with salt and pepper. Sear skin-side down 5 minutes.
Flip; cook 2 more minutes.
Mix honey, soy sauce, garlic, vinegar, and sesame oil. Pour over chicken.
Bake at 400°F for 25 minutes, basting halfway. Garnish and serve.

title: Pad Thai
description: Classic Thai stir-fried rice noodles with egg, bean sprouts, and a tangy tamarind sauce.
ingredients: Lime and crushed peanuts to serve
instructions: Soak noodles in warm water 20 minutes; drain.
Stir-fry noodles in oil over high heat 2 minutes.
Push aside; scramble eggs in the pan.
Add bean sprouts and sauce ingredients; toss everything together.
Serve with lime, green onions, and crushed peanuts.

title: Chicken Caesar Wrap
description: Grilled chicken, crisp romaine, Parmesan, and Caesar dressing wrapped in a warm tortilla.
instructions: Warm tortillas in a dry pan 30 seconds per side.
Toss romaine with Caesar dressing.
Layer chicken, lettuce, Parmesan, and croutons on each tortilla.
Fold and wrap tightly. Slice in half and serve.

title: French Onion Soup
description: Deeply caramelised onion soup topped with crusty croutons and melted Gruyère.
instructions: Slowly caramelise onions in butter with sugar over low heat for 45 minutes.
Add wine and reduce 5 minutes. Add broth and thyme; simmer 20 minutes.
Ladle into oven-safe bowls. Top with baguette slices and Gruyère.
Broil until cheese is bubbly and golden.

title: Shakshuka
description: Eggs poached in a spiced tomato and pepper sauce — a one-pan Mediterranean classic.
instructions: Sauté onion and peppers in olive oil until soft. Add garlic and spices.
Stir in tomatoes and simmer 10 minutes.
Make 6 wells; crack an egg into each.
Cover and cook on low heat until whites are set but yolks are still runny.
Garnish with parsley and serve with bread.

title: Butter Chicken
description: Tender chicken simmered in a velvety, mildly spiced tomato and butter sauce.
instructions: Marinate chicken in yogurt and 1 tsp garam masala for 1 hour.
Grill or broil until charred. Set aside.
Sauté onion purée in butter until golden. Add remaining spices and tomatoes; simmer 15 minutes.
Blend sauce until smooth. Return to pan with cream and chicken.
Simmer 5 minutes. Serve with naan or rice.

title: Falafel with Tzatziki
description: Crispy chickpea falafel balls served with cool, herby tzatziki and warm pita.
instructions: Blend chickpeas, onion, garlic, parsley, and spices until a coarse paste forms.
Mix in flour. Refrigerate 30 minutes.
Shape into balls and deep-fry at 375°F for 3–4 minutes until golden.
Serve with tzatziki and pita.

title: Miso Ramen
description: Rich miso broth with ramen noodles, soft-boiled egg, and fresh toppings.
instructions: Whisk miso paste into warm broth. Add sesame oil; keep at a gentle simmer.
Cook ramen noodles per package instructions; drain.
Divide noodles between bowls. Ladle broth over.
Top with corn, bean sprouts, egg, nori, and green onions.

title: Korean Bibimbap
description: A vibrant bowl of seasoned rice topped with vegetables, gochujang, and a fried egg.
instructions: Sauté each vegetable separately in sesame oil, seasoning with soy sauce.
Fry eggs sunny-side up.
Divide rice between bowls. Arrange vegetables on top.
Add fried egg. Serve with gochujang and sesame seeds.

title: Beef Bulgogi
description: Tender marinated beef strips grilled to sweet-savory perfection — a Korean barbecue staple.
instructions: Mix soy sauce, sugar, sesame oil, garlic, ginger, and grated pear.
Marinate beef for at least 1 hour in the fridge.
Grill or pan-fry over high heat in batches, 1–2 minutes per side.
Garnish with sesame seeds and green onions. Serve with rice.

title: Vietnamese Pho
description: Silky rice noodles in a deeply aromatic beef bone broth with fresh herbs.
ingredients: 1 lb beef sirloin, very thinly sliced
Bean sprouts, lime, basil, hoisin to serve
instructions: Simmer bones with charred onion, ginger, and spices for 4 hours. Strain broth.
Season broth with fish sauce and salt.
Cook noodles; divide into bowls. Top with raw beef slices.
Ladle boiling broth over to cook the beef. Serve with garnishes.

title: Dal Makhani
description: Black lentils slow-cooked with butter, cream, and warming spices — rich and comforting.
instructions: Pressure-cook lentils and beans until very soft.
Sauté cumin in butter. Add onion until golden; add ginger-garlic paste.
Stir in tomato purée and garam masala; cook 5 minutes.
Add cooked lentils, simmer 20 minutes. Finish with cream.

title: Chicken Shawarma
description: Middle-Eastern spiced chicken wraps with pickled vegetables and garlic sauce.
instructions: Mix spices and olive oil; coat chicken. Marinate 1 hour.
Grill or pan-fry chicken until cooked through. Slice thinly.
Warm pitas. Layer chicken, pickled vegetables, and garlic sauce.
Wrap tightly and serve.

title: Vegetable Paella
description: Saffron-infused rice with artichokes, peppers, and green beans in a smoky broth.
instructions: Sauté onion, garlic, and peppers in olive oil. Add smoked paprika and saffron.
Stir in rice and coat with the oil. Add warm broth.
Spread evenly; add green beans and artichokes. Do not stir.
Cook on medium-low 20 minutes until liquid is absorbed and a crust forms.

title: Lentil Soup
description: A warming, hearty red lentil soup seasoned with cumin, coriander, and lemon.
instructions: Sauté onion and garlic in olive oil. Add spices and cook 1 minute.
Add lentils and broth; bring to a boil then simmer 25 minutes.
Blend half the soup for a creamy texture. Stir back in.
Finish with lemon juice. Serve with crusty bread.

title: Lamb Tagine
description: Moroccan slow-cooked lamb with apricots, preserved lemon, and aromatic spices.
instructions: Brown lamb in olive oil in batches. Set aside.
Sauté onion and garlic. Add spices; cook 1 minute.
Return lamb to pot. Add apricots, preserved lemon, and broth.
Cover and braise at 325°F for 1.5–2 hours until very tender. Serve with couscous.

title: Sweet Potato Curry
description: Creamy, warming sweet potato and coconut curry with red lentils and spinach.
instructions: Sauté onion in coconut oil. Add curry paste and turmeric; cook 1 minute.
Add sweet potatoes and lentils. Pour in tomatoes and coconut milk.
Simmer 25 minutes until lentils and potatoes are tender.
Stir in spinach. Season and serve with rice or naan.

title: Chicken Noodle Soup
description: Classic comfort soup with tender chicken, vegetables, and egg noodles in a golden broth.
instructions: Simmer chicken in broth 20 minutes. Remove and shred.
Add carrots, celery, onion, and garlic to broth; cook 10 minutes.
Add noodles and cook per package instructions.
Return chicken. Season and garnish with parsley.

title: Beef Enchiladas
description: Corn tortillas filled with seasoned beef, smothered in red enchilada sauce and cheese.
ingredients: Sour cream and jalapeños to serve
instructions: Brown beef with onion, garlic, and spices. Drain fat.
Warm tortillas; fill with beef, roll tightly, and place seam-down in a baking dish.
Pour enchilada sauce over; top with cheese.
Bake at 375°F for 20 minutes until bubbling. Serve with sour cream.

title: Tiramisu
description: Classic Italian dessert with espresso-soaked ladyfingers and a mascarpone cream.
instructions: Beat egg yolks and sugar until pale. Fold in mascarpone until smooth.
Mix espresso with liqueur. Quickly dip ladyfingers and layer in a dish.
Spread half the cream over the ladyfingers. Repeat layers.
Dust with cocoa powder. Refrigerate at least 4 hours before serving.

title: Pulled Jackfruit Tacos
description: Tender shredded jackfruit with chipotle sauce tucked into soft corn tortillas.
instructions: Shred jackfruit with forks. Sauté onion and garlic; add jackfruit and spices.
Blend chipotle peppers with some adobo sauce; stir into jackfruit.
Cook on medium heat 15 minutes until caramelised.
Serve in warm tortillas with avocado, cabbage, and lime.

title: Mushroom Tacos
description: Roasted portobello mushrooms with chipotle crema and pickled red onion in corn tortillas.
instructions: Toss mushrooms with olive oil, paprika, and cumin.
Roast at 425°F for 20 minutes until caramelised.
Warm tortillas. Layer mushrooms, avocado, and pickled onion.
Garnish with coriander and serve with lime.

title: Cauliflower Fried Rice
description: Low-carb cauliflower rice stir-fried with vegetables, soy sauce, and egg.
instructions: Rice cauliflower in a food processor. Sauté in oil over high heat 5 minutes.
Push aside; scramble eggs. Add garlic and frozen vegetables; stir-fry 3 minutes.
Toss everything together with soy sauce and sesame oil.
Serve topped with green onions.

title: Teriyaki Salmon
description: Glazed salmon fillets with a sweet-salty homemade teriyaki sauce over steamed rice.
ingredients: Sesame seeds and green onions to serve
instructions: Mix soy sauce, mirin, sake, and sugar to make teriyaki sauce.
Marinate salmon 15 minutes. Reserve marinade.
Pan-sear salmon 3 minutes per side.
Pour reserved marinade into pan; reduce to a glaze and coat salmon.
Serve over rice with sesame seeds and green onions.

title: Baked Mac and Cheese
description: Creamy three-cheese macaroni baked until golden and bubbling with a crispy breadcrumb top.
instructions: Cook pasta until al dente. Make a béchamel with butter, flour, and milk.
Stir in cheddar and Gruyère. Mix with pasta. Season with nutmeg.
Transfer to a baking dish. Top with Parmesan and breadcrumbs.
Bake at 375°F for 25 minutes until golden and bubbling.

title: Lamb Kofta
description: Spiced lamb mince skewers grilled until charred and served with hummus and flatbread.
instructions: Mix all ingredients together until well combined. Refrigerate 30 minutes.
Shape mince around skewers into long sausage shapes.
Grill over high heat 3–4 minutes per side until charred.
Serve with hummus, flatbread, and a fresh herb salad.

title: Chicken Fajitas
description: Sizzling strips of marinated chicken with peppers and onions in warm flour tortillas.
instructions: Toss chicken and vegetables with fajita seasoning and olive oil.
Cook in a very hot cast-iron skillet until chicken is cooked and vegetables are charred.
Warm tortillas directly over a gas flame.
Serve sizzling with sour cream, guacamole, and salsa.

title: Butternut Squash Soup
description: Smooth and velvety roasted butternut squash soup with a hint of nutmeg and ginger.
ingredients: Crème fraîche and pumpkin seeds to serve
instructions: Roast squash cut-side down at 400°F for 45 minutes until very tender.
Sauté onion, garlic, and ginger in olive oil.
Scoop squash flesh into a blender with onion mixture and broth. Blend until smooth.
Season with nutmeg, salt, and pepper. Serve with crème fraîche and seeds.

title: Quinoa Buddha Bowl
description: Nourishing bowl of quinoa, roasted vegetables, chickpeas, and a tahini dressing.
instructions: Cook quinoa per package instructions. Season with salt.
Roast chickpeas and sweet potato at 400°F for 25 minutes.
Whisk tahini, lemon juice, and maple syrup with water to a drizzleable consistency.
Assemble bowls with all components. Drizzle with tahini dressing.

title: Garlic Butter Shrimp
description: Juicy shrimp sautéed in garlic butter with white wine, parsley, and a squeeze of lemon.
instructions: Melt butter in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add garlic and red pepper flakes.
Add shrimp in a single layer; cook 1 minute per side.
Add wine and cook 1 more minute until sauce reduces slightly.
Finish with lemon juice and parsley. Serve with crusty bread.

title: Pineapple Fried Rice
description: Fragrant Thai-style fried rice in a pineapple shell with cashews and curry powder.
instructions: Heat oil in a wok over high heat. Scramble eggs; push aside.
Add rice, breaking up clumps, and stir-fry 3 minutes.
Add curry powder and soy sauce; toss well.
Stir in pineapple, cashews, and green onions. Serve in pineapple halves if desired.

title: Palak Paneer
description: Soft cubes of fresh cheese simmered in a silky, spiced spinach sauce.
instructions: Blend blanched spinach into a smooth purée.
Sauté onion in ghee until golden. Add garlic, ginger, and spices.
Stir in spinach purée; simmer 5 minutes.
Add paneer cubes and heat through. Garnish with cream.

title: Crispy Tofu Bowl
description: Baked crispy tofu over brown rice with edamame, cucumber, and a ginger miso dressing.
instructions: Press and cube tofu. Toss with soy sauce and cornstarch.
Bake at 400°F for 25 minutes until crispy.
Cook brown rice. Whisk miso, vinegar, ginger, and sesame oil into a dressing.
Assemble bowls with rice, tofu, edamame, and cucumber. Drizzle with dressing.

title: Tom Yum Soup
description: Spicy-sour Thai soup with shrimp, mushrooms, and fragrant lemongrass.
instructions: Bring broth to a simmer with lemongrass, lime leaves, and galangal.
Add mushrooms and simmer 5 minutes.
Add shrimp; cook 2 minutes until pink.
Season with fish sauce and lime juice. Add chillies. Garnish with coriander.

title: Chocolate Lava Cake
description: Warm, gooey chocolate fondant cakes with a molten centre — a dinner-party showstopper.
instructions: Melt chocolate and butter together; cool slightly.
Whisk eggs, yolks, and sugar until light. Fold into chocolate.
Fold in flour and salt.
Pour into buttered ramekins. Bake at 425°F for 12 minutes. Invert and serve immediately with ice cream.

title: Chicken Piccata
description: Sautéed chicken cutlets in a bright, tangy lemon-caper butter sauce.
instructions: Dredge chicken in flour, shaking off excess.
Pan-fry in butter 3 minutes per side until golden. Remove.
Deglaze with wine; add broth, lemon juice, and capers. Simmer 3 minutes.
Return chicken to sauce; heat 1 minute. Garnish with parsley.

title: Mushroom Stroganoff
description: Creamy, tangy mushroom stroganoff served over egg noodles — a hearty vegetarian dinner.
instructions: Sauté mushrooms and onion in butter until golden. Add garlic.
Stir in flour; cook 1 minute. Add broth and simmer 5 minutes.
Remove from heat; stir in sour cream and mustard. Season well.
Serve over cooked egg noodles with fresh parsley.

title: Fish Tacos
description: Battered white fish in corn tortillas with slaw, avocado crema, and pickled jalapeños.
ingredients: 1 lb white fish fillets (cod or tilapia)
instructions: Season fish with chilli powder, cumin, salt, and pepper.
Pan-fry in oil 3 minutes per side until flaky.
Blend avocado, yogurt, and lime juice into a crema.
Fill warm tortillas with fish, slaw, crema, and pickled jalapeños.

title: Beef Burritos
description: Loaded flour tortillas with seasoned beef, rice, beans, and all the fixings.
instructions: Brown beef with taco seasoning. Warm black beans and rice.
Warm tortillas. Layer rice, beans, beef, corn, and cheese in each.
Fold sides and roll tightly. Toast in a dry pan for a golden crust.
Serve with salsa and sour cream.

title: Greek Moussaka
description: Layers of seasoned beef, roasted aubergine, and creamy béchamel baked until golden.
instructions: Salt aubergine slices; let sit 20 minutes, rinse, and roast at 400°F until soft.
Brown beef with onion, garlic, and spices. Add tomatoes; simmer 15 minutes.
Make béchamel: melt butter, whisk in flour, gradually add milk. Remove from heat; whisk in yolks.
Layer: aubergine, meat sauce, béchamel. Bake at 375°F for 40 minutes.

title: Chicken Quesadillas
description: Crispy grilled quesadillas filled with seasoned chicken, peppers, and melted cheese.
instructions: Mix shredded chicken with cumin, chilli powder, peppers, and onion.
Spread chicken and cheese over half of each tortilla. Fold.
Cook in a dry pan over medium heat 2–3 minutes per side until golden.
Slice into wedges and serve with sour cream and guacamole.

title: Salmon Poke Bowl
description: Hawaiian-style bowl with marinated fresh salmon, sushi rice, and bright toppings.
instructions: Marinate salmon in soy sauce, sesame oil, and rice vinegar for 15 minutes.
Divide sushi rice between bowls.
Top with marinated salmon, avocado, edamame, and cucumber.
Garnish with sesame seeds, nori strips, and pickled ginger.

title: Chana Masala
description: Boldly spiced Indian chickpea curry in a tangy tomato and onion gravy.
instructions: Fry onions in oil until deep golden. Add garlic and ginger.
Add spices and tomato purée; cook 10 minutes until oil separates.
Add chickpeas with 1/2 cup water. Simmer 15 minutes.
Finish with amchur for tartness. Serve with bhatura or rice.

title: Beef Short Ribs
description: Slow-braised beef short ribs in a rich red wine and herb sauce until meltingly tender.
instructions: Season ribs generously; sear on all sides in olive oil. Remove.
Sauté vegetables until soft. Add tomato paste, wine, and broth.
Return ribs; add herbs. Cover and braise at 325°F for 3–3.5 hours.
Remove ribs; reduce sauce on stovetop. Spoon over ribs and serve with mash.

title: Chicken Gyros
description: Greek-spiced chicken wrapped in warm pita with tzatziki, tomato, and onion.
instructions: Marinate chicken with spices and olive oil for 1 hour.
Grill or pan-fry until golden and cooked through. Slice thinly.
Warm pitas. Spread with tzatziki.
Top with chicken, tomato, onion, and parsley. Wrap and serve.

title: Mango Sticky Rice
description: Thai dessert of sweet coconut sticky rice paired with ripe fresh mango.
instructions: Soak sticky rice overnight. Steam for 20–25 minutes until tender.
Heat coconut milk, sugar, and salt until dissolved. Pour over hot rice; let absorb 20 minutes.
Arrange sliced mango alongside rice.
Drizzle with remaining warm coconut milk and sprinkle sesame seeds.

title: Tofu Scramble
description: A protein-rich vegan alternative to scrambled eggs with turmeric, spinach, and peppers.
instructions: Sauté onion, garlic, and pepper in olive oil 3 minutes.
Add crumbled tofu, turmeric, cumin, and nutritional yeast; cook 5 minutes.
Stir in spinach until wilted. Season with salt and pepper.
Serve on toast or with roasted vegetables.

title: Beef Kebabs
description: Spiced beef skewers grilled over charcoal and served with flatbread and fresh salad.
instructions: Mix all ingredients; knead until the mixture holds together well.
Shape firmly around flat skewers into sausage shapes.
Grill over high heat 3–4 minutes per side until charred.
Serve with flatbread, tomato salad, and tahini.

title: Veggie Spring Rolls
description: Crispy fried spring rolls filled with glass noodles, cabbage, carrots, and mushrooms.
instructions: Stir-fry garlic, mushrooms, cabbage, and carrots 3 minutes. Add noodles and soy sauce.
Cool filling. Place 2 tbsp in each wrapper; roll tightly, sealing with water.
Deep-fry at 350°F in batches until golden and crispy.
Serve with sweet chilli dipping sauce.

title: Cauliflower Buffalo Wings
description: Crispy baked cauliflower florets tossed in tangy buffalo sauce — all the heat, zero chicken.
instructions: Mix flour, water, garlic powder, and onion powder into a batter. Coat florets.
Bake on a lined sheet at 425°F for 20 minutes until golden.
Toss with buffalo sauce and vegan butter. Return to oven 10 minutes.
Serve with celery sticks and blue cheese or ranch dip.

title: Mango Avocado Salad
description: Bright tropical salad with sweet mango, creamy avocado, red onion, and a lime dressing.
instructions: Combine mango, avocado, red onion, and red pepper in a bowl.
Whisk lime juice, olive oil, salt, and chilli flakes.
Pour dressing over salad. Toss gently.
Garnish with fresh coriander and serve immediately.

title: Chicken Katsu Curry
description: Japanese crispy breaded chicken in a mild, sweet curry sauce served over steamed rice.
instructions: Bread chicken: dust with flour, dip in egg, coat in panko.
Deep-fry at 350°F for 6–8 minutes until golden. Rest on a rack.
Curry sauce: sauté onions until deep golden. Add curry powder; cook 1 minute.
Add broth, honey, and soy sauce; simmer 15 minutes. Blend smooth. Serve over rice with sliced chicken.

title: Black Bean Quesadillas
description: Crispy quesadillas stuffed with spiced black beans, corn, and gooey melted cheese.
instructions: Mash beans with cumin and smoked paprika.
Spread bean mixture and cheese over half of each tortilla; fold.
Cook in a dry pan over medium heat 2–3 minutes per side until golden and cheese melts.
Slice into wedges. Serve with sour cream, salsa, and avocado.

title: Açaí Bowl
description: Thick, frozen açaí smoothie topped with granola, fresh fruit, honey, and coconut flakes.
instructions: Blend frozen açaí, banana, and almond milk until thick and smooth.
Pour into bowls.
Top with granola, berries, banana slices, and coconut flakes.
Drizzle with honey and serve immediately.

title: Minestrone Soup
description: Classic Italian vegetable soup with beans, pasta, and a rich tomato herb broth.
instructions: Sauté onion, carrot, celery, and garlic in olive oil until softened.
Add tomatoes, broth, and Parmesan rind. Simmer 15 minutes.
Add zucchini, beans, and pasta. Cook 10 minutes until pasta is tender.
Remove rind. Season and serve with fresh basil and Parmesan.

title: Chicken Marsala
description: Tender chicken cutlets in a rich Marsala wine and mushroom sauce.
instructions: Dredge chicken in flour; pan-fry in butter and oil 3 minutes per side. Remove.
Sauté mushrooms until golden. Add Marsala; reduce by half.
Add broth; simmer 5 minutes.
Return chicken; heat through. Finish with cold butter for a glossy sauce.

title: Zucchini Fritters
description: Crispy pan-fried zucchini cakes with feta and fresh herbs, served with sour cream.
instructions: Salt grated zucchini; let sit 10 minutes. Squeeze out excess moisture.
Mix zucchini with feta, eggs, flour, green onions, dill, salt, and pepper.
Heat oil in a pan. Drop heaped spoonfuls; flatten slightly.
Fry 3 minutes per side until golden. Serve with sour cream.

title: Chicken Biryani
description: Aromatic basmati rice layered with spiced chicken, fried onions, and fragrant saffron.
ingredients: Pinch of saffron in warm milk
instructions: Marinate chicken in yogurt and spices for 2 hours.
Fry onions in ghee until crispy golden; set aside.
Parboil rice until 70% cooked.
Layer: chicken on bottom, then rice, fried onions, herbs, and saffron milk. Cover tightly and cook on low 30 minutes.

title: Lemon Ricotta Pasta
description: Light and creamy pasta with whipped ricotta, fresh lemon zest, and peas.
instructions: Cook pasta in salted water until al dente. Reserve 1 cup pasta water.
Beat ricotta with Parmesan, lemon zest, and juice until smooth.
Toss hot pasta with ricotta mixture, adding pasta water to loosen.
Stir in peas and olive oil. Garnish with basil.

title: Beef Ragu Pasta
description: Slow-cooked beef ragu with rich tomatoes and red wine tossed through pappardelle.
instructions: Brown beef in olive oil; set aside. Sauté vegetables until soft.
Add wine; reduce by half. Add tomatoes and beef.
Braise at 300°F for 2.5 hours until beef shreds easily. Pull apart.
Toss with cooked pappardelle and Parmesan.

title: Lamb Souvlaki
description: Grilled lamb skewers marinated in lemon, garlic, and oregano — a Greek BBQ classic.
ingredients: Pita bread, tzatziki, and tomato to serve
instructions: Mix olive oil, lemon juice, oregano, garlic, salt, and pepper.
Marinate lamb for at least 2 hours. Thread onto skewers.
Grill over high heat 3–4 minutes per side until charred and cooked through.
Serve with warm pita, tzatziki, and fresh tomato.

title: Smoked Salmon Bagel
description: Toasted bagel with cream cheese, smoked salmon, capers, and thinly sliced red onion.
instructions: Slice and toast bagels until golden.
Spread cream cheese generously on both halves.
Layer smoked salmon over the bottom half.
Top with capers, red onion, and dill. Serve with lemon wedges.

title: Aloo Gobi
description: Indian dry-cooked cauliflower and potato in an aromatic blend of turmeric and spices.
instructions: Heat oil; sauté onion until golden. Add garlic and dry spices.
Add potatoes; stir-coat in spices. Cook 5 minutes.
Add cauliflower florets and a splash of water. Cover and cook 15 minutes on medium-low.
Garnish with fresh coriander. Serve with roti or rice.

title: Chicken Parmesan
description: Crispy breaded chicken cutlets baked in marinara and smothered with melted mozzarella.
instructions: Bread chicken: dip in egg, then breadcrumbs mixed with Parmesan and garlic powder.
Pan-fry in oil until golden on each side; transfer to a baking dish.
Spoon marinara over each cutlet. Top with mozzarella.
Bake at 400°F for 15 minutes until cheese is golden. Garnish with basil.

title: Miso Glazed Salmon
description: Salmon fillets with a sweet white miso and mirin glaze, broiled until caramelised.
instructions: Whisk miso, mirin, sake, sugar, and sesame oil into a glaze.
Coat salmon; marinate in the fridge for at least 1 hour.
Wipe off excess marinade. Broil on high for 8–10 minutes until caramelised.
Garnish with green onions and sesame seeds. Serve with rice.

title: Lamb Biryani
description: Fragrant basmati rice layered with slow-cooked spiced lamb and golden fried onions.
ingredients: 1 tsp saffron dissolved in 1/4 cup milk
instructions: Marinate lamb in yogurt and biryani spice mix for 2 hours. Cook in ghee until tender.
Fry onions until crispy; set aside.
Parboil rice to 70% done.
Layer lamb, rice, onions, mint, and saffron milk in a pot. Seal and cook on the lowest heat for 30 minutes.

title: Seafood Paella
description: Spanish saffron rice with mussels, shrimp, and clams cooked in a flavourful stock.
instructions: Sauté onion, garlic, and pepper in olive oil. Add paprika and saffron.
Add rice; coat in oil. Pour in warm broth. Spread evenly.
Arrange seafood on top; push partway into rice.
Cook on medium-low 20 minutes without stirring until rice is cooked and crust forms.

title: Pesto Pasta
description: Linguine tossed in vibrant homemade basil pesto with cherry tomatoes and Parmesan.
instructions: Blend basil, pine nuts, garlic, and Parmesan. Slowly add olive oil until smooth.
Cook linguine in salted water until al dente. Reserve 1/2 cup pasta water.
Toss hot pasta with pesto, adding pasta water to loosen.
Fold in cherry tomatoes. Serve with extra Parmesan.

title: Duck Confit
description: French slow-cooked duck legs cured in salt and herbs, crisped in their own fat.
ingredients: Duck fat or olive oil to cover
instructions: Rub duck legs with salt, garlic, thyme, bay, and pepper. Refrigerate overnight.
Rinse and pat dry. Submerge in duck fat in an oven-safe dish.
Cook at 275°F for 2.5–3 hours until very tender.
Increase oven to 450°F for the last 15 minutes to crisp the skin.

title: Caprese Bruschetta
description: Grilled sourdough topped with burrata, heirloom tomatoes, basil oil, and flaky sea salt.
instructions: Grill sourdough slices; rub while hot with a cut garlic clove.
Blend basil with olive oil into a loose basil oil.
Arrange tomato slices on each toast. Tear burrata over the top.
Drizzle with basil oil and balsamic glaze. Finish with flaky sea salt.

title: Korean Fried Chicken
description: Double-fried ultra-crispy chicken wings glazed in a sweet and spicy gochujang sauce.
instructions: Season wings with salt and pepper; coat in cornstarch. Fry at 340°F for 8 minutes; drain.
Raise oil to 375°F. Fry a second time for 3 minutes until very crispy.
Mix gochujang, honey, soy sauce, garlic, and sesame oil in a pan over low heat.
Toss crispy wings in the sauce. Serve with sesame seeds.

title: Crème Brûlée
description: Classic French silky vanilla custard with a perfectly caramelised sugar crust.
ingredients: 80g sugar plus extra for the crust
1 vanilla pod or 1 tsp vanilla extract
instructions: Heat cream with vanilla until just steaming; remove from heat.
Whisk yolks and sugar until pale. Slowly pour in warm cream, whisking.
Strain into ramekins. Bake in a water bath at 300°F for 35–40 minutes until set with a slight wobble.
Refrigerate 2 hours. Sprinkle sugar on top and brulee with a torch.

title: Shrimp Tacos with Mango Salsa
description: Spiced pan-fried shrimp in corn tortillas with a fresh, sweet mango-jalapeño salsa.
instructions: Mix mango, jalapeño, red onion, lime juice, coriander, and salt into a salsa.
Toss shrimp with chilli powder, cumin, and salt.
Pan-fry shrimp in oil 1–2 minutes per side until pink.
Serve in warm tortillas topped with mango salsa.

title: Grilled Swordfish
description: Meaty swordfish steaks marinated in lemon and herbs and grilled to perfection.
ingredients: Lemon wedges and capers to serve
instructions: Marinate swordfish in lemon juice, olive oil, garlic, and oregano for 30 minutes.
Grill over medium-high heat 4 minutes per side.
Rest 2 minutes. Serve with lemon wedges, capers, and a green salad.

title: Sweet and Sour Pork
description: Crispy pork pieces with pineapple and peppers in a tangy sweet-and-sour sauce.
instructions: Coat pork in egg then cornstarch. Deep-fry at 375°F until golden; drain.
Mix vinegar, ketchup, sugar, and soy sauce into a sauce.
Stir-fry peppers 2 minutes. Add sauce; bring to a boil.
Add pork and pineapple; toss to coat. Serve with steamed rice.

title: Pesto Gnocchi
description: Pillowy potato gnocchi tossed in vibrant basil pesto with roasted cherry tomatoes.
instructions: Roast cherry tomatoes with olive oil at 400°F for 15 minutes until blistered.
Cook gnocchi in salted boiling water until they float; drain.
Toss hot gnocchi immediately with pesto.
Top with roasted tomatoes, Parmesan, and fresh basil.

title: Tom Kha Gai
description: Creamy Thai coconut soup with chicken, galangal, lemongrass, and kaffir lime.
instructions: Simmer broth with lemongrass, galangal, and lime leaves for 5 minutes.
Add coconut milk and bring to a gentle simmer.
Add chicken and mushrooms; cook 5 minutes until chicken is done.
Season with fish sauce and lime juice. Add chillies. Serve with coriander.

title: Pulled Chicken Sandwiches
description: Tender slow-cooked BBQ pulled chicken on a brioche bun with tangy coleslaw.
instructions: Place chicken, BBQ sauce, broth, paprika, and garlic powder in a slow cooker. Cook on low 6 hours.
Shred chicken and mix back into sauce.
Combine coleslaw mix with mayonnaise and vinegar.
Pile pulled chicken onto brioche buns with a heap of coleslaw.

title: Ratatouille
description: French Provençal slow-cooked vegetable stew with tomatoes, courgette, and herbes de Provence.
instructions: Sauté onion and garlic in olive oil until soft. Add herbes de Provence.
Add aubergine and peppers; cook 5 minutes. Add courgette.
Stir in fresh tomatoes and canned tomatoes. Season well.
Simmer uncovered 30 minutes until vegetables are tender and sauce thickens. Serve with crusty bread.

title: Prawn Pad Thai
description: Wok-tossed flat rice noodles with tiger prawns, egg, tamarind, and spring onions.
ingredients: Lime, spring onions, and crushed peanuts to serve
instructions: Soak noodles in warm water 20 minutes; drain.
Stir-fry prawns in oil until pink; push aside and scramble eggs.
Add noodles; toss over high heat 2 minutes.
Add tamarind, fish sauce, and sugar; toss well. Add bean sprouts.
Serve with lime, spring onions, and peanuts.

title: Smoothie Bowl
description: Thick blended açaí and berry smoothie base loaded with colourful toppings and seeds.
ingredients: Fresh kiwi, strawberry, and banana slices
instructions: Blend açaí, blueberries, banana, and coconut milk until very thick.
Pour into a bowl.
Arrange granola, kiwi, strawberry, and banana artfully on top.
Sprinkle with chia seeds and hemp seeds. Drizzle honey and serve immediately.
